Liberty Community Christmas Tree Program accepting applications until Nov. 6
Liberty's Community Christmas Tree Program is taking applications for holiday help through Friday, Nov. 6 at 5 p.m.
The Liberty Community Christmas Tree Program has opened applications for families and individuals seeking help with children's gifts or food this holiday season, according to the City of Liberty. The firm deadline to apply is Friday, Nov. 6 at 5 p.m., and the city said no late applications will be accepted.
The program has served local families, children and seniors for more than 40 years, according to the city, and continues to grow each season because of community donations. The city described the program's growth as happening "thanks to our community's incredible generosity."
Residents who need assistance with children's gifts or food during the holidays are encouraged to apply before the deadline. The city said more information about volunteer and shopper opportunities for the program will be announced soon.
Details about eligibility guidelines and the online application are available through the city, which directed residents to its website for the full application process. The announcement was posted by the City of Liberty on Friday, Oct. 30, 2026.
The program is administered through the Liberty Community Center, according to the city's announcement. Those interested in applying are urged to complete the process before the Nov. 6 cutoff, as the city emphasized that the deadline will not be extended for late submissions.
Source: City of Liberty, https://www.libertymissouri.gov/CivicAlerts.aspx?aid=5524
